findings.motion: Co-author of HJR 161, constitutional amendment on citizenship to vote
findings.note: HJR 161 (89th Legislature, 2025) was authored by Rep. Noble. Its official bill page lists this member in the co-author list. Last action shown: laid on the table subject to call, 2025-05-09. The Senate version, SJR 37, proposed a constitutional amendment 'clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen.'

findings.motion: Listed among House co-sponsors of SJR 37, constitutional amendment on citizenship to vote
findings.note: SJR 37 (89th Legislature, 2025) is titled 'Proposing a constitutional amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen.' Its House sponsor was Rep. Noble. The official bill page lists this member in the list that follows the House sponsor. The page's action list shows House third reading on 2025-05-10 and adoption on 2025-05-12.

Listed as co of TX-HB-2739-2025 on the official Texas Legislature authors page (identity step 2026-10-28: printed name matched to one 89th Legislature member of that chamber, then to the roster by surname and first initial).
